source: hand-authored for ApexMaps, verified against Natural Earth 5.1.1 centroids and shared-arc adjacency
boundaries: The six states plus the ACT and the Northern Territory. The three external-territory codes in au/admin1@10m (Ashmore and Cartier, Jervis Bay, Macquarie Island) are unplaced: they are not units anyone reports state-level data for.
compromises: ACT is drawn beside NSW rather than inside it, which is the only way a hex grid can show an enclave at all.
